BL-1570 — test_operator_runtime_fixture_reaper_sweep_liveness_undetermined.sh and test_operator_runtime_sandbox_sweep_liveness_undetermined.sh are red on every Linux host with no owner: both construct the liveness-undetermined case by forcing lsof absent and RELYING on /proc being absent (a macOS assumption written into their headers), so on Linux/WSL liveness is determined and the orphan is reaped - they point SWARMFORGE_PROC_DIR, the seam BL-877 shipped in the same commit, at a directory that does not exist
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: proc_fd_scan_lib.bb, fixture_reaper_sweep_lib.bb and sandbox_sweep_lib.bb are not touched - the SWARMFORGE_PROC_DIR seam already exists and already makes both files pass (verified on ma…
